_about: One entry per registered lesson. Each gemini-notebook/<slug>/ owns its PROMPT.txt, upload variants in assets/, and prep notes. Canonical teaching and boards stay in lessons/ and course-assets/. scripts/video/sync_gemini_notebook.py refreshes only upload/, README.txt, and MANIFEST.json; edit sources and this registry, never generated copies. 'post_only' boards replace their 'covers' upload variants in the edit. Raw rolls and candidates stay in Prompts/. lessons contains current-method standard prep only. needs_preparation has no usable prompt or generated bundle. retired_kits records superseded experiments without keeping their prompts. AI Brain Break retains a separate activity-specific brief outside the standard registry.
